end_to_end.note: P(stage-1 CONFIRM and stage-2 ACCEPT), enumerated exactly over both stages' binomial outcomes at the supported set alone. The whole-suite vetoes (a collapse or a security rise on an unsupported task) and the behavioral Fisher comparison are NOT modeled, and can only lower a real detection rate, so every number here is an upper bound.

false_confirm.note: P(evaluate() returns CONFIRM) with nothing changed. `marginal` draws both arms from the null model; `conditional` fixes the designated baseline arm's own recorded counts and draws only the candidate arm, which is the comparison this pipeline actually makes.
